## Release to build

Access to fabrication equipment follows clear preparation and safety requirements. Everyone can earn access by showing the required planning and understanding.

## Make, inspect, adjust

Fabricate using the available process, then measure and inspect the result. Record what changed between the design file and the physical part.

## Build routines

Tool selection, setup, cleanup, return of equipment, and documentation are part of technical competence.
